video_subject: Someone is sending you USDT? Don't make this beginner mistake.
video_script: The biggest mistake is copying a deposit address before checking the network. A sender can transfer the same stablecoin over different blockchain networks. If the sending network and receiving network don't match, you can create a serious problem. Confirm the network first, then copy the address from the official receive or deposit screen.
